title: Tiny, cute television
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x="18" y="28" width="64" height="48" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- TV body lighter edge -->
  <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="44" rx="7" ry="7" fill="#ff9ec4"/>
  <!-- Screen bezel -->
  <rect x="26" y="35" width="48" height="34" rx="4" ry="4" fill="#3a1a4d"/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x="29" y="38" width="42" height="28" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#4de8ff"/>
  <!-- Screen glow reflection -->
  <rect x="31" y="40" width="18" height="8" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#b8f8ff" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cute face on screen: eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="50" r="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="3" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <!-- Eye sparkles -->
  <circle cx="43.2" cy="48.8" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.2" cy="48.8" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Cute smile on screen -->
  <path d="M43 57 Q50 63 57 57" fill="none" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush cheeks on screen -->
  <ellipse cx="37" cy="56" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="56" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ff9ec4" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- Left antenna -->
  <line x1="34" y1="28" x2="28" y2="14" stroke="#ff6b9d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="12" r="3.5" fill="#ffd45e"/>
  <!-- Right antenna -->
  <line x1="66" y1="28" x2="72" y2="14" stroke="#ff6b9d" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="12" r="3.5" fill="#ffd45e"/>
  <!-- Left foot -->
  <rect x="26" y="76" width="16" height="7" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#c44a7a"/>
  <!-- Right foot -->
  <rect x="58" y="76" width="16" height="7" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#c44a7a"/>
  <!-- Knobs left side -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="42" r="3" fill="#ffd45e"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="52" r="3" fill="#ffd45e"/>
  <!-- Small speaker lines right side -->
  <line x1="79" y1="42" x2="79" y2="60" stroke="#c44a7a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="82" y1="44" x2="82" y2="58" stroke="#c44a7a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
